source_quote: There is literally nothing to trade now.
text: Regime: the bull case has fully played out and ES broke out of the yellow macro bull flag (7770). There is nothing to trade now — he waits for price to digest the move via a dip or a sideways basing period, and trades only when ES goes elevator down into a Failed Breakdown.

trigger.condition_text: post-breakout digestion; no entry until a dip sets up a Failed Breakdown

source_quote: 7790 is first support down. Not a strong support but if you want to engage here this is a spot to try.
text: 7790 is first support down — not a strong support; a spot to try for those who want to engage, but he won't personally.

source_quote: First support of any interest now is 7770 to backtest the flag we broke out. One could try buying this directly if its a slow, controlled sell into the zone. If we are knifing down at full speed, there is a safer entry around 7760 though.
text: First support of any interest is 7770, a backtest of the flag breakout: buy it directly if the sell into it is slow and controlled. If price is knifing down at full speed, the safer entry is around 7760 — Failed Breakdowns of that 9:20AM low are actionable.

trigger.condition_text: slow sell into 7770 = bid; fast knife = wait for the 7760 Failed Breakdown

source_quote: If its a slow grind into the zone, one can try the bid there but if we are knifing just forget about it.
text: Below 7760 there is nothing of interest for quite a ways. 7740 is a high-risk long he won't touch: a bid only on a slow grind into the zone, and forget it if price is knifing.

source_quote: For those who want to try though, 7831 is a spot to try and 7867.

source_quote: Generally though in a parabolic, extreme bull case, ES will hold 7770 (or not even test it, and simply resume up). In a more mild bull case, ES can retrace down to 7760 and put in the Failed Breakdown there.

source_quote: For the 7760 short, ideally price can put in one final bounce here, OR a Failed Breakdown, and then one can short beneath the lows of that bounce at 7755 or so.
text: Bear case: none for a very long way down. For those who like to gamble, losses of 7760 are possibly actionable — ideally after one final bounce or a Failed Breakdown, short beneath the lows of that bounce at 7755 or so. Around 80% of breakdowns trap; he does not take these.
